factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s sales amounted to 28 590 thousand EUR during the 06 months of 2026, representing a 0.6% increase as compared to the same period for the previous year. Reported consolidated net profit for 06 months of 2026 amounted to 4 321 thousand EUR, as compared to net profit of 6 279 thousand EUR in the prior year’s same period.

factual_claims.claim: Revenue increased 0.6% year on year to EUR 28.590 million, while gross profit rose 5.3% to EUR 15.892 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s sales amounted to 28 590 thousand EUR during the 06 months of 2026, representing a 0.6% increase as compared to the same period for the previous year. The Group’s gross profit during the 06 months of 2026 amounted to 15 892 thousand EUR and increased by 5.3% compared to 06 months of 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Gross margin improved to 55.6% from 53.1%, supported by a 4.8% reduction in the cost of goods sold.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Gross margin during the 06 months of 2026 increased to 55.6% from 53.1% as compared to 06 months of 2025. The cost of sold goods decreased by 4.8%.

factual_claims.claim: The improvement in gross profit did not translate into higher operating earnings.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated operating profit for 06 months of 2026 decreased by 3.5% to 5 751 thousand EUR, compared to 5 961 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit declined 3.5% to EUR 5.751 million, reducing the operating margin to 20.1% from 21.0%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated operating profit for 06 months of 2026 decreased by 3.5% to 5 751 thousand EUR, compared to 5 961 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025. The consolidated operating profit margin was 20.1% for 06 months of 2026 (21.0% for 06 months of 2025).

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA decreased 0.8% to EUR 7.508 million, with the EBITDA margin broadly stable at 26.3% versus 26.6% in the prior-year period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated EBITDA for 06 months of 2026 decreased by 0.8% and was 7 508 thousand EUR, compared to 7 566 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025. EBITDA margin = EBITDA / revenue = 7,508 / 28,590 = 26.3% (26.6% for 06 months of 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Distribution expenses increased to EUR 6.912 million from EUR 6.230 million, and administrative expenses rose to EUR 3.084 million from EUR 2.672 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Distribution expenses: 6,912 thousand EUR (06m 2026) vs 6,230 thousand EUR (06m 2025). Administrative expenses: 3,084 thousand EUR (06m 2026) vs 2,672 thousand EUR (06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Net profit fell 31.2% to EUR 4.321 million, while profit attributable to the parent company’s shareholders declined 31.5% to EUR 3.961 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Reported consolidated net profit for 06 months of 2026 amounted to 4 321 thousand EUR, as compared to net profit of 6 279 thousand EUR in the prior year’s same period. Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company for 06 months of 2026 amounted 3 961 thousand EUR (5 781 thousand EUR for 06 months of 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share decreased to EUR 0.11 from EUR 0.16.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Earnings per share (EUR): 0,11 (06m 2026) vs 0,16 (06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: The lower result reflected the reduction in net finance income, which fell to EUR 0.444 million from EUR 1.652 million, as well as higher income tax expense of EUR 1.870 million compared with EUR 1.322 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net finance income: 444 thousand EUR (06m 2026) vs 1,652 thousand EUR (06m 2025). Income tax expense: 1,870 thousand EUR (06m 2026) vs 1,322 thousand EUR (06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Net profit attributable to parent-company shareholders represented 13.9% of revenue, down from 20.3%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net profit margin attributable to equity holders of the Parent company: 13.9% (06m 2026) vs 20.3% (06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Performance was affected by a shift in sales mix.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Retail revenue increased by 13.6% and amounted 13 548 thousand EUR, this represents 47.4% of the Group’s total revenue (06 months of 2025: 41.9%). Wholesale revenue decreased by 9.1% to 14 934 thousand EUR (52.2% of total revenue vs 57.8% in 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Retail revenue increased 13.6% to EUR 13.548 million and accounted for 47.4% of total sales, compared with 41.9% a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Our retail revenue increased by 13.6% and amounted 13 548 thousand EUR, this represents 47.4% of the Group’s total revenue (06 months of 2025: 41.9%).

factual_claims.claim: Wholesale revenue decreased 9.1% to EUR 14.934 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: During 06 months of 2026 wholesale revenue amounted to 14 934 thousand EUR, representing 52.2% of the Group’s total revenue (06 months of 2025: 57.8%).

factual_claims.claim: Russia remained the largest market, generating EUR 15.767 million, down 0.6% in euros and 7.8% in local currency.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s sales on the Russian market totalled 15 767 thousand EUR, decrease is 0.6% compared to 06 months of 2025. Local currency sales decreased by 7.8% during 06 months of 2026 compared to the same 06 months of 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Belarus sales increased 6.4% to EUR 9.046 million, while Ukraine and the Baltics recorded declines.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s sales in Belarus in the 06 months of 2026 were 9 046 thousand EUR and increased by 6.4% compared to the 06 months of 2025. Ukraine: 15 thousand EUR (06m 2026) vs 36 thousand EUR (06m 2025). Baltics: 484 thousand EUR (06m 2026) vs 581 thousand EUR (06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Russia and Belarus together represented 86.7% of total sales.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Group sales in its 2 major markets – Russia and Belarus– were 86.7% of its total sales.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow almost doubled to EUR 6.842 million from EUR 3.481 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Operating cash flow for the period: 6,842 thousand EUR (06m 2026) vs 3,481 thousand EUR (06m 2025).

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents increased 87.4% from year-end 2025 to EUR 12.443 million, while total assets rose 5.1% to EUR 98.603 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash and cash equivalents: 12,443 thousand EUR (30.06.2026) vs 6,639 thousand EUR (31.12.2025) [increase of 87.4%]. Total assets: 98,603 thousand EUR (30.06.2026) vs 93,847 thousand EUR (31.12.2025) [increase of 5.1%].

factual_claims.claim: Parent-attributable equity increased 6.1% to EUR 81.479 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Total equity attributable to equity holders of the Parent company: 81,479 thousand EUR (30.06.2026) vs 76,768 thousand EUR (31.12.2025) [increase of 6.1%].

factual_claims.claim: The Group operated 135 own stores and 412 franchise stores at period-end, and employed 1,594 people, down from 1,639 at 31 December 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: At the end of the reporting period the Group and its franchising partners operated 525 Milavitsa and 22 Lauma Lingerie brand stores, including 135 stores operated directly by the Group (as of 31 December 2025: 137 stores). As of 30 June 2026, the Group employed 1 594 people (as of 31 December 2025: 1 639 people).
